Third-party license notice: Turbo color map
===========================================

DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite contains the color values of the Turbo color
map ("turbo") designed by Anton Mikhailov at Google, as published by Vega
(https://github.com/vega/vega) and d3-scale-chromatic
(https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic) as a polynomial approximation of the
map. The Turbo color map is released under the Apache License, Version 2.0; the
notice below is reproduced exactly as it appears in the header of the published
Turbo color map source file
(https://gist.github.com/mikhailov-work/ee72ba4191942acecc03fe6da94fc73f), and the
text of the Apache License, Version 2.0 is shipped in the file
LICENSE-apache-2.0.txt next to this file.

This project is not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by,
Google LLC or the author of the Turbo color map.
